name: std::ctype_byname

declarations.code:
template <class CharT>

class ctype_byname : public std::ctype<CharT>;

intro: std::ctype_byname is a std::ctype facet which encapsulates character classification rules of the locale specified at its construction.

sections.title: Specializations
sections.text:
The standard library is guaranteed to provide the following specializations:

Defined in header <locale> 



 std::ctype_byname<char>

 provides narrow character classification (uses table lookup for character classification)




 std::ctype_byname<wchar_t>

 provides wide character classification

 (since C++11) 



Constructs a new std::ctype_byname facet for a locale with name. 
refs is used for resource management: if refs == 0, the implementation destroys the facet, when the last std::locale object holding it is destroyed. Otherwise, the object is not destroyed.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: std::ctype_byname<char> was incorrectly declared as an explicit specialization in the synopsis of <locale>, and the declaration was removed by the resolution of LWG issue 1298, but it remains a required specialization, just like std::ctype_byname<wchar_t>.
